name: opensees_example_effective_stress_slope
disabled_reason: Both engines complete gravity and 200 shaking steps. The solvers diverge in plastic gravity and the resulting displacement and strain histories exceed the normal recorder tolerances.
reference: Dynamic 2D Effective Stress Analysis of Slope, Christopher McGann and Pedro Arduino, University of Washington.
notes: The October 26, 2010 Wiki script, reconstructed byte for byte. Both engines run the published gravity sequence and up to 200 shaking steps at the computed time increment.
